cases.behavior: Keep every unclassified target in a mixed Verify write pending Agent judgment.
cases.reproduction: The corresponding PR #539 CI test failed on commit 56744e50. Reproduce the independent behavior in its isolated project with the exact test selector below; local results and platform limitations are recorded in docs/research/2026-11-05-pr539-ci-repair.zh.md.
cases.expected: Keep the candidate and require a judgment for the unknown target.
cases.forbidden: Treating a mixed source write as neutral because another target is documentation.
cases.rootCause: A documentation target caused an early return before the remaining source targets were inspected.

tests.namePattern: ^(?:preserves a Verify candidate for resource messages and holds unclassified mixed writes|holds an unclassified material write mixed with documents in Verify)$
requiredNames: preserves a Verify candidate for resource messages and holds unclassified mixed writes
holds an unclassified material write mixed with documents in Verify

cases.behavior: Bind actual post-command source inputs and reject incomplete generated inputs.
cases.reproduction: The corresponding PR #539 CI test failed on commit 56744e50. Reproduce the independent behavior in its isolated project with the exact test selector below; local results and platform limitations are recorded in docs/research/2026-11-05-pr539-ci-repair.zh.md.
cases.expected: Reject a source-changing command until explicit repair and reject incomplete snapshots.
cases.forbidden: Accepting changed source or reusing a stale complete observation.
cases.rootCause: The raw executor gate duplicated the pre-command observation instead of binding the post-command snapshot.

tests.namePattern: ^(?:rejects source-changing checks and recovers to Build only after the repair approval|rejects checks whose initially incomplete generated inputs disappear during execution)$
requiredNames: rejects source-changing checks and recovers to Build only after the repair approval
rejects checks whose initially incomplete generated inputs disappear during execution

tests.namePattern: ^keeps completed check results but rejects unjudged source writes during the check$
requiredNames: keeps completed check results but rejects unjudged source writes during the check

cases.behavior: Replace stale completed applied-edit proposals while requiring a review of the current content.
cases.reproduction: The corresponding PR #539 CI test failed on commit 56744e50. Reproduce the independent behavior in its isolated project with the exact test selector below; local results and platform limitations are recorded in docs/research/2026-11-05-pr539-ci-repair.zh.md.
cases.expected: Preserve every user edit, block the pending latest review and finish after its real receipt.
cases.forbidden: Accepting the latest bytes solely because an older edit was reviewed.
cases.rootCause: Supersession skipped completed non-behavioral applied reviews, leaving an old branch of the approved edit graph blocking newer content.

tests.namePattern: ^(?:keeps later user edits and supersedes stale pending and completed applied reviews)$
requiredNames: keeps later user edits and supersedes stale pending and completed applied reviews

cases.behavior: Recover the original interrupted command plan without inferring a replacement build.
cases.reproduction: The corresponding PR #539 CI test failed on commit 56744e50. Reproduce the independent behavior in its isolated project with the exact test selector below; local results and platform limitations are recorded in docs/research/2026-11-05-pr539-ci-repair.zh.md.
cases.expected: Run the original validated plan and reject a corrupt SDK Action binding.
cases.forbidden: Inferring another build or executing a mismatched Action.
cases.rootCause: The not-executed checkpoint hid the original command plan from the interrupted-check lookup.

tests.namePattern: ^(?:preserves and reruns an interrupted check instead of inferring another build|does not rerun an interrupted check with a corrupted SDK Action binding)$
requiredNames: preserves and reruns an interrupted check instead of inferring another build
does not rerun an interrupted check with a corrupted SDK Action binding

cases.behavior: Record the original Verifier failure when its machine overlay has been lost.
cases.reproduction: The corresponding PR #539 CI test failed on commit 56744e50. Reproduce the independent behavior in its isolated project with the exact test selector below; local results and platform limitations are recorded in docs/research/2026-11-05-pr539-ci-repair.zh.md.
cases.expected: Keep the original task identity and preserve missing local evidence.
cases.forbidden: Fabricating a passed check or replacing a lost local overlay with empty evidence.
cases.rootCause: Failure persistence required a local overlay even when the portable dispatch still identified the original task.

tests.namePattern: ^(?:keeps the dispatched identity when the machine overlay is lost)$
requiredNames: keeps the dispatched identity when the machine overlay is lost
